result.reason: The operative language does not add any aggregate liability cap and therefore reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. It also removes the indemnification carve-out from the consequential-damages exclusion, contrary to the required minimum carve-outs, while failing to add carve-outs for gross negligence, wilful misconduct, data/security obligations, fraud, or IP infringement. The margin comment cannot cure these defects because its proposed terms are not included in the clause; moreover, it describes a different formulation for payment obligations and narrower carve-outs than the preferred position. The deletion materially changes the existing indemnification risk allocation, and the clause retains the punctuation error after “REPRESENTATIVES.”
